cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(deepzip_standalone VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
option(DEEPZIP_WITH_HDF5 "Build native upstream checkpoint importer" ON)
option(DEEPZIP_WITH_CUDA "Build GPU predictor (required for FULL_PARITY)" OFF)
option(DEEPZIP_SANITIZERS "Enable address/undefined sanitizers" OFF)
add_library(deepzip STATIC src/deepzip.cpp src/model.cpp)
target_include_directories(deepzip PUBLIC include PRIVATE src)
target_compile_features(deepzip PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(deepzip PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-Wall;-Wextra;-Wpedantic;-fno-fast-math;-ffp-contract=off>)
if(DEEPZIP_WITH_HDF5)
  find_package(HDF5 REQUIRED COMPONENTS C)
  target_sources(deepzip PRIVATE src/hdf5.cpp)
  target_include_directories(deepzip PRIVATE ${HDF5_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_link_libraries(deepzip PUBLIC ${HDF5_LIBRARIES})
else()
  target_sources(deepzip PRIVATE src/hdf5_stub.cpp)
endif()
if(DEEPZIP_WITH_CUDA)
  enable_language(CUDA)
  find_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)
  target_sources(deepzip PRIVATE src/cuda.cu)
  target_link_libraries(deepzip PUBLIC CUDA::cudart)
  set_target_properties(deepzip PROPERTIES CUDA_STANDARD 17 CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON CUDA_RUNTIME_LIBRARY Shared)
  target_compile_options(deepzip PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:--fmad=false;--objdir-as-tempdir>)
else()
  target_sources(deepzip PRIVATE src/cuda_stub.cpp)
endif()
if(DEEPZIP_SANITIZERS)
  target_compile_options(deepzip PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(deepzip PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
add_executable(deepzip_cli tools/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(deepzip_cli PRIVATE deepzip)
add_executable(deepzip_tests tests/test_deepzip.cpp)
target_link_libraries(deepzip_tests PRIVATE deepzip)
add_executable(deepzip_entropy_replay tools/entropy_replay.cpp)
target_include_directories(deepzip_entropy_replay PRIVATE src)
target_link_libraries(deepzip_entropy_replay PRIVATE deepzip)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME standalone_preflight COMMAND deepzip_tests ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/biGRU.dzm)
install(TARGETS deepzip deepzip_cli ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION include)
install(FILES README.md contract_v1.md PORT_MANIFEST.yaml NATIVE_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.yaml DESTINATION share/deepzip)
install(DIRECTORY LICENSES/ DESTINATION share/deepzip/LICENSES)
